model_comparison_note: Client-cluster bootstrap intervals quantify uncertainty. Prefer the simpler Cox model when intervals overlap unless calibration or operational value justifies LightGBM.

interval_calibration.method: split conformal quantile regression on validation paid invoices
interval_calibration.caveat: Paid-only calibration; censoring and client dependence limit marginal coverage guarantees.

drift_backtest.lead_time_definition: Days from signal snapshot to the first subsequent late invoice due date, among true-positive clients with a future missed due date.
drift_backtest.outcome_definition: No invoice issue in the next 90 days, or future paid-invoice median delay at least 7 days above the preceding median.

caveat: These synthetic-cohort metrics verify the pipeline only; they do not establish real-world forecast accuracy.

policy_simulation.label: Simulation · assumed effects, not observed uplift
policy_simulation.assumption: At due+3, eligible friendly/firm reminders have a 10% chance of advancing settlement by up to five days. No causal effect is estimated from synthetic outcomes.
